description: Hovercart wash and wax at Bubble Bay, $20
body: Took the Glidemaster through the Bubble Bay wash and wax: $20. The purple is shiny again.

description: Mrs. Grimsby elected gnome association president; Mr. Pumpernickel stepped down to treasurer
body: At a special meeting of the gnome association, Mr. Pumpernickel stepped down as president, citing his gout. Mrs. Grimsby was elected president, 14 votes to 3. Mr. Pumpernickel became treasurer.
